description: Get full financial statement metrics per fiscal period — all entity_financial_metrics columns. Includes cash_and_equivalents, inventories, receivables, liabilities, equity, cost breakdown, revenue lines. The standalone row of the latest analysed statement also has `notes` (additional information from the statement): average employment (employees_avg, employees_avg_prev), income tax, profit distribution and dividend, parent and ultimate parent, related-party transactions, shareholdings, guarantees and contingent liabilities, loans, auditor fee, revenue split. Every row has `insights`: the financial signals shown on the Compabase profile for that year and scope (plain-text sentences, e.g. negative equity, cash share of current assets), and `metric_summaries`: the sentences next to each statement line on the profile ({ revenue_total: [...], ebitda: [...], equity: [...], … }, with y/y change and structure). Both in `lang` with amounts in `currency`; [] / {} when none. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

currency.description: Currency of amounts inside `insights` and `metric_summaries` (default pln). Statement figures stay in PLN.

krs.description: KRS number of the company in the Polish National Court Register (10 digits).

name.description: Company name, used when the KRS or NIP is not known.

nip.description: Polish company tax number (NIP) of the business, 10 digits.

name: get_financials
title: Get Full Financial Statements
